items.headline: Small Craft Advisory issued November 22 at 12:17PM EST until November 24 at 6:00AM EST by NWS Mount Holly NJ
items.description:
* WHAT...Northwest winds 10 to 20 kt with gusts up to 25 kt and
seas 5 to 8 ft.

* WHERE...Portions of Atlantic coastal waters.

* WHEN...Until 6 AM EST Tuesday.

* IMPACTS...Conditions will be hazardous to small craft.
items.instruction:
Inexperienced mariners, especially those operating smaller
vessels, should avoid navigating in hazardous conditions.
